# Conversion notes

The Markdown pages in this repository were converted from **Confluence Template.pdf**. There is one file per Confluence page. A page with subpages is a folder: the folder's `README.md` is the parent page, and the other files in it are its children. The repository's top-level `README.md` is the space home page. Numeric prefixes keep the Confluence page order.

This file sits inside `.github/`, so it is not uploaded to Confluence.

## Notes

- **Space home:** the space home page (PDF p. 3) is the top-level `README.md`, followed by a page index.
- **Project Canvas** was rebuilt from a screenshot of the canvas (`04-project-canvas/README.md`); each cell header links to its subpage.
- **Images and embeds** (the example architecture diagram and the Sailboat retrospective board) are not in the source text. Each one has a placeholder line.
- **External links:** the source text kept link labels but lost their URLs. The labels are kept as plain text. Links between pages were rebuilt as relative links.
- **Merged cells** in the Sprint Review form cannot be shown in Markdown. They are approximated with a 4-column table.
- **Numbered tables** (Confluence auto-numbered rows) have a `#` column.
- **Text is verbatim**, typos included (e.g. "Definiton", "seperate", "Plese", "Data Updated:").
